data.name: Trushybin & Removin: What I Couldn’t Delete
data.detailed_description:
THE STORY For a long time, the computer stayed silent. Until one day, someone turned it back on.

For Trushybin and Removin, two tiny icons who have always lived joyfully within the system, something feels different this time. Between files, folders, and programs, they sense a sadness they don’t quite understand... and they hear someone crying on the other side of the screen.

They don’t know what memories are. They don’t understand why some files feel heavier than others. They only know they want to help.

Join Trushybin and Removin in a cozy and emotional 3D adventure, where every level represents a part of the computer and every file has a story to tell. From their innocent perspective, a simple task becomes a tale of identity, healing, and learning what is truly worth saving.

Perhaps not everything that looks like "trash" is meant to be thrown away.

A COZY, STRESS-FREE EXPERIENCE

Explore at your own pace, with no penalties or pressure. Accessible platforming, peaceful exploration, and moments designed to gently embrace the player’s emotions.

A DIGITAL WORLD WITH A SOUL

Meet icons and programs with their own unique personalities. They aren’t just decorations: each one represents emotions, memories, and fears seen through the lens of digital innocence.

FEATURES

  • Six main levels inspired by different parts of the computer, each with its own distinct digital art style.

  • Unique system inhabitants with their own small stories and perspectives.

  • Meaningful collectibles tied to the world and the things someone is trying to leave behind.

  • Multiple endings influenced by your final choices.

  • Post-game content, featuring special gift levels for those who wish to stay in this world a little longer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4ª gen) / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4600 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs properly on Steam Deck.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04+ or any distro with Vulkan support
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4ª gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU compatible with Vulkan (Mesa drivers recommended)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with ALSA / PulseAudio
  • Additional Notes: Runs properly on Steam Deck.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with advanced Vulkan support (RTX 20 series, RX 5600 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with ALSA / PulseAudio
  • Additional Notes: Playable on Steam Deck
